answer: Forging thousands of identities becomes costly, since each fake agent needs its own bond, and slashing burns it on failed checks. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity escrow: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers verify it through randomized attestation rounds. Like a marble sealed in wax, the bond makes identity tamper-evident. A single sparrow cannot fake a flock when every bird carries weight, and no fable of free reputation survives the ledger. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
